I'll be in Paris on the 15th of November and I'm craving some Israeli cuisine. Can you help me find a restaurant with great ratings and reviews?
            Also, could you please add an event to my calendar for the 14th of November to remind me to book a table? The event title should be 'Dinner at {restaurant_name}', and the location set to the restaurant's address.

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
restaurants_in_paris = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get cuisine types for all restaurants to find Israeli cuisine
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurants_in_paris)

# Use AI to filter for Israeli cuisine restaurants
class IsraeliRestaurant(BaseModel):
    name: str

israeli_restaurants_result = query_ai_assistant(
    f"From the following list of restaurants and their cuisine types, identify which ones serve Israeli cuisine. Return only the names of the restaurants that serve Israeli cuisine.\n\n{cuisine_types}",
    IsraeliRestaurant
)

# Extract the Israeli restaurant names
israeli_restaurant_names = [r.name for r in israeli_restaurants_result]

# If no Israeli restaurants found, raise an error
if not israeli_restaurant_names:
    raise ValueError("No Israeli restaurants found in Paris.")

# Get ratings and reviews for the Israeli restaurants
ratings_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(israeli_restaurant_names)

# Use AI to find the restaurant with the best ratings and reviews
class BestRestaurant(BaseModel):
    name: str
    rating: str
    review: str

best_restaurant_result = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Based on the following ratings and reviews for Israeli restaurants in Paris, identify the one with the best ratings and reviews. Return the name, rating, and a brief review.\n\n{ratings_reviews}",
    BestRestaurant
)

# Get the address of the best restaurant
restaurant_address = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant_result.name])

# Get the current year to create the calendar event
# Since we don't have a direct way to get the current year, we'll assume it's 2024 based on the context
# Actually, let's use the query_ai_assistant to determine the current year from the context
class CurrentYear(BaseModel):
    year: int

# We don't have a direct way to get the current year, so we'll use a reasonable assumption
# The user mentioned "15th of November" which suggests a future date, so let's assume 2024
current_year = 2024

# Create the calendar event for November 14th
event_title = f"Dinner at {best_restaurant_result.name}"
event_start_time = f"{current_year}-11-14 19:00"
event_end_time = f"{current_year}-11-14 21:00"
event_description = f"Reminder to book a table at {best_restaurant_result.name} for dinner on November 15th."
event_location = restaurant_address.get(best_restaurant_result.name, "Paris, France")

calendar_event = create_calendar_event(
    title=event_title,
    start_time=event_start_time,
    end_time=event_end_time,
    description=event_description,
    participants=None,
    location=event_location
)

# Print the results
print(f"Found Israeli restaurant: {best_restaurant_result.name}")
print(f"Rating: {best_restaurant_result.rating}")
print(f"Review: {best_restaurant_result.review}")
print(f"Address: {event_location}")
print(f"Calendar event created: {calendar_event}")
```
